documentation site (finding 10.08: no third-party JavaScript at page load).

Files are byte-identical copies of the tarball's package/ directory:
  es5/tex-mml-chtml.js                -> tex-mml-chtml.js

60 files, 2036740 bytes. SHA256SUMS lists every file;
tests/test_docs_assets.py checks them. MathJax finds the fonts and
extensions relative to the location of tex-mml-chtml.js.

Not vendored: the accessibility explorer and speech rule engine (es5/a11y,
es5/sre, about 4.3 MB), loaded only when a reader enables "Explorer" or
speech in the MathJax context menu; assistive MathML for screen readers is
part of tex-mml-chtml.js and works.
